maria-cs: Quick Day0 check for Aquilon private/VPC onboarding 1: ensure routing, egress, KMS access, and audit ingestion are green. Any immediate showstoppers?
tom-se: Peering established. Missing route for telemetry subnet 10.40.2.0/24 -> tgw-aaa. I can push if needed.
anya-eng: Also noticed KMS key policy is scoped to account-root only. Customer wants cross-account decrypt from `arn:aws:iam::999888777:role/aquilon-ops`.
raj-infra: Pushed route at 07:12Z; propagation state "available" now. Ran curl from proxy -> collector: TCP handshake OK but 403 from collector (IP not whitelisted).
infra-bot: trail_create: "aquilon-org-trail" @ 2026-03-02T07:05Z
tom-se: Collector IP is 35.77.88.99. Customer needs to add this to their firewall allowlist.
anya-eng: KMS fix: adding policy statement for ops role and granting kms:Decrypt,kms:GenerateDataKey. I'll draft snippet into runbook.
maria-cs: Risk: if customer doesn't approve KMS policy by Fri we flag renewal risk. Adding to tracker now.
tom-se: Added risk "KMS approval lag" w/ mitigation: temp ingest key we manage (audit only).
raj-infra: CloudTrail PutObject initially 403 due to bucket policy deny; fixed by adding explicit allow for `cloudtrail.amazonaws.com`. Re-delivery attempted and succeeded.
maria-cs: Excellent. Actions: raj confirm collector accept after allowlist; anya paste KMS snippet and DM PM; tom schedule follow-up Fri 09:00 UTC. Mark telemetry and audit ingestion as green conditional on whitelist. Thanks :thumbsup:
